name: NumberPortingRequestManager
tagline: Port-in and port-out requests from LOA to cutover – validation, FOC lead times, rejections and a cutover board in one Power Platform control.
description: A complete number portability back office for mobile and fixed operators, MVNOs and resellers: dashboard, request grid, pipeline board, rejection workbench and cutover board. Checks donor account number, LOA validity and port-out PIN before submission, enforces FOC lead times per number type and porting days, tracks rejection codes with suggested fixes and supervisor approval for repeated resubmissions, and runs cutover day with numbers-live progress, completion and fall back. Handles bulk number ranges. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped, then connects to a collection, Dataverse, SharePoint or SQL table, a model-driven view or the Power Pages Web API.
features: Port-in and port-out lifecycle with transition rules
LOA, donor account and PIN validation
FOC lead time per number type, bulk extra days, porting days
FOC due, port-out response and activation clocks
Rejection codes with suggested fixes and supervisor approval
Cutover board with numbers-live progress and fall back
KPIs: FOC overdue, first-time-right, numbers in flight
Bulk actions, undo, CSV export, phone layout
controlType: standard (data-set control + Power Pages field control)
